description: The End of Day (EOD) Prices endpoint provides the closing price and other relevant metadata for a financial instrument at the end of a trading day. This endpoint is useful for retrieving daily historical data for stocks, ETFs, or other securities, allowing users to track performance over time and compare daily market movements.
